sections.description:
WHAT IS PRODUCT DESIGNER APP?

If you have a WooCommerce printing store, Product Designer App is a must-have plugin for you. Product Designer App allows your customers to design your own, edit or buy from design template. You can download file design of customer and direct print without any editing. The fee of print can be set up flexible for all printing type. Also, The plugin can supported everything customer need to design for any kind of product View Demo.

THE BEST SOLUTION FOR PERSONALIZATION STORES.

Product Designer App, the leading WordPress product designer platform, lets you build professional, flawless print websites quickly.

Revolutionize the way you build print websites with the Product Designer App. Manage design assets and integrate design assets from the free store with just one click. Add designs with artwork, text, QR codes and images instantly. Render and download print files easily with just one click.

Unlock all features with Product Designer App Pro.

🌟 Create Professional Websites

  • Admin control panel: Installation, configuration, management resources, setup layout, print, download high-resolution design files for printing…
  • Perfect Design Tools: Add text, fonts, colors, artwork, design template, Add Qrcode, Barcode, Upload photo, Add photo from library, apply shapes, filters, resize… Friendly interface.
  • Template Library: Create design template, import/export template and setup page design template allow customer use.
  • Support any kind of products: Product Designer App give your customers the freedom to design any type of products.
  • Import first data faster: You can import resources design (artwork, text, template…) by one click or use bulk uploads.
  • Perfect services: We are always there for you whenever you need us.

🗝️ Key features:

Management by Admin Panels:

  • Dashboard: Allow show total resources, orders for analytical and show system requirement status.
  • List Orders: Show list orders, order details, customer informations and allow download file to print.

  2. Backup/Restore Import, export product to file and save on computer.
  3. Import[Basic/Pro] Import free products base from library by one click.
  • Create Any Kind of Product to Design:
  1. Multiple Background Layers Can add multiple background for each elements of product
  2. Multiple Area Design Can add multiple area design for one view
  3. Mask Layer Add masking layer for realistic product design
  4. Custom View[Basic/Pro] Allow customer add custom view
  5. Change Product Colors Set colors by list or color picker
  6. Attributes/Variants[Basic/Pro] Setup size and add other extra attributes (Ex: material…)
  7. Discount Set discount with quantity
  8. Layout Can set up suitable layout for each product
  9. Resources Can set artwork, design templates by category for each product
  10. Management Variants[Basic/Pro] Management stock and extra price for each variants of product design
  • Management Artworks:
  1. Management Bulk upload new artworks, Bulk edit, Bulk move, Bulk delete, search artworks
  2. Upload File type format SVG, PNG, JPG
  3. Import[Basic/Pro] Import free artworks from library by one click.
  4. Folder Management artworks by folder (Can move, delete folder)
  5. Price[Basic/Pro] Set price for artwork
  6. Language Multiple languages
  • Management Templates:
  1. Management Create new template, edit, move, delete, search templates
  2. Editor Create, edit design template via design tool with all resources like design tool for customer
  3. Control Element Show/hide control for each template element function
  4. Backup/Restore Import, export template to file and save on computer
  5. Import[Basic/Pro] Import free templates from library by one click
  6. Folder Management templates by folder (Can move, delete folder)
  7. Price[Basic/Pro] Set price for template
  8. Language Multiple languages
  • Management Printing Type:
  1. Management Create new, edit, delete printing type
  2. Calculation Element Can set fixed price, price for component design, color, size and area design size
  3. Combines It is possible to combine multiple types of calculations (color, size, composition…) in one print
  4. Discount Support setting discounts by quantity and number of views have designed
  5. Interface Intuitive setup by price list
  • Management Themes:
  1. Management Install, activate, deactivate theme
  2. Customize Easy CSS editing via editor
  3. Upgrade Easy upgrade new version by one click
  4. Install New Get new themes and install from library
  • Management Settings:
  1. Upload Allow setup min, max size upload and file type customer can upload
  2. File Format Allow setup file type customer can download from design tools
  3. Text Remove emoji from text and support tool setup text default
  4. Photo Library[Basic/Pro] Setup use photo from photos library
  5. Text Team[Pro] Setup text default for team member
  6. Qrcode/Barcode[Basic/Pro] Setup Qrcode and Barcode
  7. Watermark[Basic/Pro] Setup watermark for preview
  8. Help Video Adding embedded video tutorials from youtube
  9. Layouts Enable/disabled any functions for text, photos… on design tool
  10. Text Template Import free text templates from library or create new text template by tool
  11. Fonts Import free fonts from library, use google font or upload font file from computer
  12. Shapes Import free shapes from the library or upload a standard shape file downloaded from your computer
  13. Filters Import free filters from library or upload filter file downloaded from your computer
  14. Language Easy translate new language by editor
  15. Caches Delete caches of data saved
  • Upgrades: Easy upgrade new version by one click

Management by WooCommerce:

  • Management Product WooCommerce:
  1. Setup Product Design Connect/disconnect product base design with WooCommerce product for create product design
  2. Setup Product Template Add/remove design template to product design for create product template
  3. Customize Button Show button Customize for WooCommerce product design
  • Management cart WooCommerce:
  1. Add Design to Cart Save design information to cart
  2. Thumbnail of Design Create design thumbnails and display them on the shopping cart
  3. Price Update product design price on cart
  4. Cart Page Support basic cart and cart block of WooCommerce
  • Management order WooCommerce:
  1. Save Design to Order Save design information to order details
  2. Thumbnail of Design Save design thumbnails and display them on the order details, email details
  3. File Print Download high quality file formats SVG, PNG (Basic & Pro), PDF (Pro)

– Shortcode Shortcode for design page: [pdapp-studio-page id=”1″]

Design tools:

  • Browser Support multiple browsers
  • Devices Responsive layout on multiple devices
  • Interface Friendly and beautiful
  • Upload File type format PNG, JPG, SVG
  • Work in Background Supports multiple background tasks. So you can design images while uploading files to the server
  • SVG Technology It can work faster with high resolution
  • Multiple Area Design Support design across multiple area designs with the same view
  • Change Elements Color Changing the color of product components using the color picker or color list
  • Security Protect requests and hide resources folder
  • Supports Support multiple languages ​​and Auto detect the language in use
  • Save Design[Pro] Save and load design saved
  • Get a Quote[Pro] Submit a quote request for multiple variations of the same design at once
  • Add Design to Cart Support adding multiple variations of the same design to cart
  • Hotkeys[Basic/Pro] Support many basic hotkeys
  • Design Notes Save design notes to cart and display on order details

  • Move, Resize, Rotate Drag and drop to move, drag to resize and rotate design elements

  • Supports Many Tools for Design:

  1. Back Button Back to product and quit design
  2. Size of Area Design[Basic/Pro] Customer can change size print they want
  3. Groups Design Select all designs to set the group or design all selected components
  4. Reset Button Clear all designs exists to start new design

  9. Zoom Button Zoom in/out for easier design
  10. Expand Button Expand/exit full screen for easier design
  11. View Button Change view for design

  1. *Add Template** Add new template from library by one click

  4. Edit Design Customer can use functions supported for each element like text, photo…
  5. Hide Functions You can disable any functionality for each element if you don’t want customers to edit it
  • Text Element:
  1. Add Text Easily add new text from the sample text library or from the default text list with just one click
  2. Edit Text Edit text, fonts, font size, colors, spacing, opacity, outline, text style…
  3. Alignment Customer can move, resize, rotate text
  4. Actions Copy, lock, flip, delete text
  • Artwork Element:
  1. Add Artwork Easily add new artworks from library with just one click
  2. File Format PNG, SVG, JPG
  3. Edit Artwork Support change color element for SVG standard only and change opacity artwork
  4. Alignment Customer can move, resize, rotate artwork
  5. Actions Copy, lock, flip (PNG, JPG only), delete artwork
  • Photo Element:
  1. Add Photo Easily add new photos from library[Basic/Pro] or upload your own by one click
  2. File Format PNG, SVG, JPG
  3. Adjustment Support crop, shape, filter for PNG, JPG only
  4. Alignment Customer can move, resize, rotate photo
  5. Actions Copy, lock, flip (PNG, JPG only), change opacity, delete photo
  • Teams Element[Pro]:
  1. Add Team Easily add new name and number of teams member by one click
  2. Edit Team Edit name or number, fonts, font size, colors, spacing, opacity, outline, text style…
  3. Alignment Customer can move, resize, rotate team
  4. Actions Lock, delete team
  • Qrcode Element[Basic/Pro]:
  1. Add Qrcode Easily add new Qrcode by one click
  2. Edit Qrcode Edit Qrcode content, change color, background, opacity, correct level
  3. Qrcode Type Text, link url, phone, sms or email
  4. Alignment Customer can move, resize, rotate Qrcode
  5. Actions Copy, lock, delete Qrcode
  • Barcode Element[Pro]:
  1. Add Barcode Easily add new Barcode by one click
  2. Edit Barcode Edit Barcode content, change color, background, opacity, width, height
  3. Barcode Type CODE128, EAN/UPC, CODE39, ITF14, MSI, PHARMACODE, CODABAR
  4. Barcode Text Show/hide text content under Barcode
  5. Alignment Customer can move, resize, rotate Barcode
  6. Actions Copy, lock, delete Barcode
  • Group Elements:
  1. Select Element Select multiple elements design by mouse click + keyboard or drag mouse on elements
  2. Group Group/ungroup elements selected
  3. Edit Group Change color of elements in group for SVG element only
  4. Alignment Customer can move, resize, rotate group
  5. Actions Copy, delete group

– Layer Management:
1. Sort Layers Move layer up or down
1. Activation a Layer Click on layer to select and edit

Build professional websites with Product Designer App Pro!

🚫 Notice

  • No support block checkout of WooCommerce
  • No support variants of WooCommerce product. You can setup Single product to work

❓ Help support

Join us for get a help.

  • Report – Report a bug
  • Request – Request features
  • Documents – Documents
  • Facebook – Follow us for get new notification.
  • Twitter – Follow us for get new notification.

  • Learn valuable insights and techniques from our YouTube Channel.

  • If you have questions or need support. You can get support with Basic/Pro version Help Center – Find FAQs to answer your questions or open a new ticket for support.

  • Show your support by rating us on WordPress. Your feedback fuels our growth! 🤗

Dependency library

All dependency have MIT license with latest version and you can find all source code uncompressed for development

  1. Barcode
  2. ChartJs
  3. CircleType
  4. ColorThief
  5. Hotkeys
  6. jsPDF
  7. Moveable
  8. Selecto
  9. Qrcode
  10. Colorpicker
  11. SvgColors
  12. VueJs

External services

This plugin connects to an API of us to obtain update notification. Also, If you are using premium version. You can connects to an API of us to import many resources (products, artworks, templates, fonts, themes) on your site.

You need send your purchased code (When use premium version you have a code sent by us) to verify before use service. Also, We only save personal Information provided by you (email address) and transaction ID when you payment via paypal. To security, we don’t use password or any other infomation of you for login. You can login with login code send via your email.

You can refer more services policy: Terms of use, Privacy policy.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 4.9 or greater
  • WooCommerce 4.0 or greater
  • PHP version 7.0 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.0 or greater

Recommended Requirements

  • PHP version 8.1 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.6 or greater
  • WordPress Memory limit of 1024 MB or greater (2048 MB or higher is preferred)

Installation

  1. Install using the WordPress built-in Plugin installer, or Extract the zip file and drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Pages > Add New
  4. Press the ‘PDA’ button to open Product Designer App admin panels.
  5. Now you can configuration, setup product and start design.

For documentation and tutorials visit our Knowledge Base.

For video tutorials visit our Youtube channel.
sections.faq:
How do I install Product Designer App?

To install the free version of Product Designer App, follow the steps below:
From your WordPress dashboard -> Go to Plugins -> Click on ‘Add new’-> In the Search field, enter Product Designer App and choose Product Designer App.
Press install -> After installation, click Activate.

Does Product Designer App work with all the themes?

Product Designer App works all the themes that respect the coding standards of WordPress set by its Codex. It is recommended to use Astra theme to working better.

Can I create an printing store?

Yes, with the Product Designer App Pro you can setup every product of your store to create an design amazing customer experience that drives sales.

Does it work with other WordPress plugins?

It works with almost all the plugins. If you experience an incompatibility issue, please report it to us and to the plugin that conflicts with Product Designer App.

Do I need to know how to code?

No! Product Designer App provides you with all the functions and features that you need to build a professional print website without using code.

Do i need to know how to design?

No, you just need to create the product design and the customer will create their own design. But, It will be better if you know a little about design. Then, You can create ready-made design for the customer to buy and that drives sales.

Will Product Designer App slow down my website?

As Product Designer App prioritizes speed and performance, you enjoy better and faster performance with each new version of Product Designer App.

Is my site secure with Product Designer App?

The security of your website is extremely important to us and we take proactive measures to assure that your websites are secure.

What is the difference between Product Designer App’s free Plugin and Product Designer App Pro

The free version of Product Designer App has similar functionality to Product Designer App Pro. Product Designer App Pro gives you more professional tools and features. Plus, you get a support package and free resource import. See the full comparison here.

Can I customize Product Designer App?

Yes, you can customize anything you need for your store. If you don’t know how to code, you can hire any developer or hire us to do it.

External services

This plugin connects to an API of us to obtain update notification. Also, If you are using premium version. You can connects to an API of us to import many resources (products, artworks, templates, fonts, themes) on your site.

You need send your purchased code (When use premium version you have a code sent by us) to verify before use service. Also, We only save personal Information provided by you (email address) and transaction ID when you payment via paypal. To security, we don’t use password or any other infomation of you for login. You can login with login code send via your email.

You can refer more services policy: Terms of use, Privacy policy.

screenshots.caption: Design tools - Add your design and tweak it for pixel-perfect results.
Add variants design - Add variations of the same design to cart.
Add cart Save all information of design to cart.
Check order - Check all information of design on order details of WooCommerce.
Download file print Download high resolution PNG, SVG or PDF file format for printing.
WooCommerce product design - Create WooCommerce products and combine with product base design to create product designs.
WooCommerce product template - Create WooCommerce products, combine with product base design and add templates to create product templates.
Dashboard - Display total resources, order statistics and system requirements.
Artworks - Manage resources (images, art) for clients to add to designs.
Orders - Display list of orders has design.
Order details - Display design details (thumbnails, uploaded images, prices, notes...) and allow downloading print files.
Quotes[Pro] - Display list of quotes sent by customers and manage list (Change status, delete...).
Quote details[Pro] - Display design details (thumbnails, uploaded images, prices, notes...) and allow downloading print files.
Prints - Display the print list and manage that list (Edit, delete...).
Add printing type - Allows to combine multiple calculations (Components, sizes, colors...) in one print and allows to set up quantity discounts, view modes.
Products base - Display list of products design and manage list (Edit, import, export, delete...).
Add product - Allows setup area design, product layers, colors, sizes, discount, layout...
Templetes - Display list of design templates and manage list (Edit, import, export, delete...).
Add templete - Allows add design template by design tools.
Themes - Allows to install, activate/deactivate theme designer.
Settings - Allows to set everything up to work (Upload, layout, resources...).
Upgrades - Display list of upgrades and allow upgrade plugin to new version.
Import resources - Allows free import resources (Artworks, templates, texts, fonts, products base...) from store.
